# 1. Early Modern Levantine Recurrent Plague Enters the Realm
oe_dis.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dis.1.title
	desc = oe_dis.1.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_dis_venice_lazaretto.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes }
			add_gold = -25
		}
		else = {
			add_gold = -45
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_dis_has_double_lazaretto = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_nuovo_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_granary_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_strict_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.1.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = yes
				has_advance = oe_dis_adv_sanita_quarantine
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_gold = -35
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_nuovo_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.1.c
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
		add_gold = 40
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_open_ports_gamble_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.1.d
		trigger = { oe_dis_has_asclepius_synergy = yes }
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
	}
}

# 90. Dev Panel Page 81 Audit Readout: Dynamic Epidemics & Lazarettos Dashboard
oe_dis.90 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_dis.90.title
	desc = {
		desc = oe_dis.90.desc_header
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_rule_off
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_dis_rule_is_mild = yes }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_rule_mild
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_rule_historic
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d1_domestic
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { disease_is_active = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d1_world
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d1_quiet
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { country_has_disease = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d2_domestic
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { disease_is_active = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d2_world
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_d2_quiet
		}
		desc = oe_dis.90.desc_buildings
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						oe_dis_has_asclepius_synergy = yes
						has_country_modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod
					}
				}
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_asclepius_on
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_asclepius_off
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes
						has_country_modifier = oe_dis_granary_epidemic_cushion_mod
					}
				}
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_granary_on
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_granary_off
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_variable = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph }
				desc = oe_dis.90.desc_triumph_done
			}
			desc = oe_dis.90.desc_triumph_pending
		}
	}
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_senate_consistorium.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.90.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_dis.90.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
	}
}
